name: Напад на зв’язану фігуру (1)
description:
The pin is a dangerous weapon. Yet a pin by itself does not always automatically win material. But a pinned piece is vulnerable because it cannot move. By increasing the pressure on the pinned piece with an additional attacker, it may be possible to win material.

What do you have to do? 

Win material by attacking a pinned piece.

examples.text: White can increase the pressure on the black knight with 1.Ng4! Black has no adequate defense against the threats.
The white knight on c3 is pinned. Black can take advantage with 1...d4! which wins material.
